name: Austrian Armed Forces (Österreichisches Bundesheer)

doctrine.summary: A neutral EU member's conscript-and-professional army built around territorial defence, disaster relief and long-running peacekeeping (KFOR in Kosovo, EUFOR Althea in Bosnia, UNIFIL in Lebanon). The 'Mission vorWärts' and Aufbauplan 2032+ programmes are rebuilding heavy capability after years of cuts: 225 Pandur Evolution 6x6 APCs ordered in 2024 (36 with Skyranger 30 anti-drone/air-defence turrets), the modernisation of 112 Ulan (ASCOD) IFVs by 2030, overhauled Leopard 2A4 tanks, UH-60M and ex-US S-70 Black Hawks and AW169 helicopters. Austria joined the European Sky Shield Initiative while remaining militarily neutral and outside NATO.
doctrine.fireteam: Gruppe of 8 in two fireteams with battle-buddy pairs; Jäger (light infantry) in Pandur or Dingo, Panzergrenadiere in Ulan.
tactics: Territorial defence of Alpine valleys and the Danube corridor
Mechanised counter-attacks with Ulan and Leopard 2A4
Jagdkommando special forces raids and hostage rescue
Peacekeeping patrols and observation posts abroad (UNIFIL, KFOR)

camo.name: Bundesheer grey-olive (legacy)
camo.use: Legacy single-colour uniform, still seen on reservists and in training

grenadier: StG 77 A1 with 40 mm underbarrel launcher

launchers: PAR 66/79 84 mm recoilless rifle (Carl Gustaf family = MAAWS [in_game])

body_armor.notes: Modern ballistic helmets and plate carriers for deployed and active units (medium); Jagdkommando heavy where needed.

vehicles.notes: Pandur Evolution 6x6 (GDELS-Steyr, Vienna): 225 ordered in 2024 for delivery by 2032, including 36 with Skyranger 30; older Pandur I 6x6 still in service. Recorded under the Pandur family file.
ASCOD Ulan, 112 being modernised by 2030 (Panzergrenadierbataillone 13 and 35).
Leopard 2A4 (Panzerbataillon 14), overhauled; 16 returned to troops in 2026.
Dingo 2 protected vehicles, used on KFOR and UNIFIL tours.
S-70A-42 Black Hawks plus UH-60M (ordered 2021-2022) and two ex-US S-70s delivered in 2026.

support_assets: Skyranger 30 counter-drone and short-range air defence (from Pandur Evolution)

unlocks: Austrian-made small arms and pistols (Steyr AUG-pattern rifles, Glock pistols)
Precision and anti-materiel rifles (Steyr SSG 08, HS .50)
Pinzgauer and Puch G utility vehicles (surplus)
Used Pandur I APC (game-level, subject to export licence)

as_client: Protect Austrian peacekeepers during the UNIFIL drawdown (lebanon_south)
Recover stolen or diverted Austrian-made weapons
Secure diplomatic venues and international organisations (Vienna-type staging hub, alpine_europe)

notes: Neutral EU state; never a target faction. In game: staging area and neutral contract source in alpine_europe, a UNIFIL contributor in lebanon_south, and a possible arms market (Steyr, Glock). Situation as of October 2026: the Bundesheer is in a large rearmament programme (Pandur Evolution, Ulan modernisation, Black Hawk and AW169 helicopters, Skyranger air defence) under the Aufbauplan 2032+, and a 2026 debate about neutrality continues; Austria remains outside NATO. UNIFIL's mandate ends on 31 December 2026, with withdrawal in 2027.
